title: The Frog (Wintersday)
wikitext:
{{Item infobox | name = The Frog [Wintersday] | rarity = 4 | image = [[Image:The Frog (Wintersday).png]] | type = [[Miniature]] | campaign= [[Core]] | render = [[File:The Frog Wintersday.jpg|150px]] }} [[The Frog (Wintersday)|The Frog [Wintersday]]] is a [[miniature]] of [[The Frog]] wearing a santa hat. It is completely unique and [[Gaile Gray]] is the only person to own one. It was a gift to her from the developers upon her leaving her role as [[ArenaNet]] Community Relations Manager, a position she held for more than five years. == Notes == * There is another alternate [[The Frog (Halloween)|Halloween version]] of the frog. * This version was first revealed during [[Wintersday 2008]]. == Trivia ==
